module: Flowgraph node "Simple Multiple Buttons" (category once_instant): multi-button version of Simple Button. For each i: inputs "hideWhenDone_i", "label_i", "order_i", "style_i"; outputs "clicked_i" (pulse), "complete_i", "incomplete_i" (hidden), "buttonId_i". The number of buttons is set in the properties.
notes: Bug: workOnce reads self.pinIn.active (nonexistent pin, error) for each button.
Unlike Simple Button, the outputs are named complete_i / incomplete_i (not used/unused).

_executionStarted.desc: Initializes hiddenAfterDone/hiddenAfterReset to false for each button.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's state from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Writes the node's state to the save table.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the editor's custom properties panel; returns a string describing the change (for the undo history) or nil.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

onNodeReset.desc: Disables each button once and resets hiddenAfterDone to false.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of pin groups (4 inputs, 4 outputs per button).

work.desc: For each button, updates clicked/complete/incomplete and disables it if hideWhenDone is set and it is completed.

workOnce.desc: Creates all the buttons and writes their ids (see notes: bug).
